scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck:app
scripts.typecheck:service: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @cat-thinking/analysis-service
scripts.build:service: npm run build:contracts && npm run build --workspace @cat-thinking/analysis-service
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck:app && vite build
scripts.lint:foundation: eslint src/analysis packages/analysis-contracts/src packages/analysis-contracts/test services/analysis-service/src services/analysis-service/test evals/analysis scripts
scripts.test:service: npm run build:contracts && vitest run services/analysis-service/test
scripts.coverage:postgres: npm run build:contracts && vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts --coverage && node scripts/verify-postgres-coverage.mjs
scripts.check:contracts: npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run test:contracts && npm run lint:contracts
scripts.check:ci: npm run lint:ci && npm run lint:foundation -- --max-warnings 0 && npm run typecheck:contracts && npm run typecheck:service && npm run coverage:check && npm run build && npm run build:service && npm run verify:fixtures
